description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.2.2: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice, a UI density setting, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin), Send to car from phone Maps, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, and a safe mode with feature switches. BYD battery, Send to car and the BYD location flicker fix are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.1 or newer.

patches.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin, off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models; a Settings row turns it on or off.

patches.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.2.2. Adds a UI density setting, a problem report and a safe mode.

patches.name: Send to car
patches.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to Maps Car through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links).

release_notes:
- A **Maps Car report** app icon sends a problem report even when Maps Car's Settings will not open. After a crash, a notification leads there.
- **Safe mode**: After two crashes within 10 minutes, Maps Car starts with its extra features off. In Maps Car report you turn them back on one at a time to find the one that crashes.
- For each crash, a report now includes the warning and error lines the crashed process wrote to the system log. Reports also catch native crashes (found at the next start) and freezes of 5 seconds or more, and name the car model, head unit software version and screen. Nothing leaves the car until you tap Send.
- BYD battery (EV), Send to car and BYD location flicker fix are now separate patches, on by default.
- UI density defaults to 200 dpi only on the Dolphin's 1920×1080 screen. Other screens keep the system density until you pick one.

Tested on a BYD Dolphin (DiLink 3.0) with Google Maps (Android Automotive) 26.10.120003.E. Other BYD models are untested, and BYD battery does not support plug-in hybrids (DM-i).

Setup: [README](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches#install).
